about: Nothing follows a markdown_block read on its line (chapter 5 § 5.2.6; #1543, ruling 2). The note, a markdown_block, ends with Sincerely, and the profile's closing after a blank line. Invalid: text after the closing on its line. Valid: alone.
sentences: Deliverable 'note' has text after {{ profile.closing }}, a markdown_block, at line 5; a markdown_block read stands alone on its line.
